name: Hermes Agent
writeNote: tk has no comment-keeping YAML writer; paste the fragment, or use `hermes mcp add`, which keeps comments (ruamel round-trip)
nameMangling: every character outside [A-Za-z0-9_] becomes _ (hyphens too); names over 64 characters are cut and given an _<8-hex sha256> suffix (V, tools/mcp_tool_schema.py#L147-L185)
listChanged: yes, ToolListChangedNotification triggers a refresh (V, tools/mcp_tool_health.py#L100-L112)
notes: Entry: command, args, env or url, headers, transport: sse for SSE (streamable HTTP by default); enabled, timeout, tools.include/exclude. No type key. ${VAR} and ${env:VAR} interpolate from the profile .env then the process environment; an unset variable stays literal (V). Folder from HERMES_HOME, default ~/.hermes (V, hermes_constants.py#L53-L59). hermes mcp add rejects entries validate_mcp_server_entry flags (V).
sources: github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent at v2026.9.24: hermes_constants.py, hermes_cli/mcp_config.py#L232-L243 and #L611-L640, website/docs/reference/mcp-config-reference.md, tools/mcp_tool_schema.py, tools/mcp_tool_health.py (lane C research, 27 Oct 2026)

gate.where: Python plugin pre_tool_call and transform_tool_result, ~/.hermes/plugins/tk/ (hermes plugins enable tk)

coverage.note: blocks on a raise and on its 30 s callback timeout (read); an ask goes to Hermes's prompt except under yolo, unattended or approvals off, where tk blocks; Hermes was never run (lane I: its install was refused), so every claim is read in source (lane I, applied by integration w2)
